messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGERS: gateway-5xx spike in us-east-1. Alert group: gateway.prod.us-east-1. Triggered at 2026-03-17T15:00:34Z

maria: seeing a sudden jump in 5xx from the gateway to upstreams. rate ~5% failures over last 5m, primarily 502/504 on /v1/generate and /v1/chat. attaching sample corr ids: corr=8f3a1b, corr=9d2c0e, corr=2a7f66

incident-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-failures — follow "initial triage" -> collect traces, kvlogs, and confirm customer impact.

josh: @maria can you paste the alert graph link and the earliest corr id? I can start pulling kvlogs+proxy logs if you give me a sample.

maria: graph: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/alert12345 — earliest spike starts at ~15:00Z. using corr=8f3a1b as sample.

sree: pulling proxy kvlogs for corr=8f3a1b now:```\n2026-03-17T15:00:35Z INFO proxy request id=8f3a1b upstream_request_id=up-34 retry_count=2 status=502 backend=runtime-pool-1 latency_ms=3400
2026-03-17T15:00:36Z INFO proxy request id=8f3a1b upstream_request_id=up-34 retry_count=3 status=502 backend=runtime-pool-2 latency_ms=3500
2026-03-17T15:00:37Z WARN proxy request id=8f3a1b upstream_request_id=up-34 status=504 backend=runtime-pool-3 latency_ms=6000
```

ben: looks like retries are amplifying the failure pattern — retry_count 2/3 + increasing latency. Are upstreams returning errors or timing out?

olivia: attaching trace bundle for 8f3a1b and a few neighbors: https://traces.redwood/trace/8f3a1b (shared). I see a pattern: downstream gateway issues repeated connect timeouts to runtime nodes around 15:00:35-15:00:40Z.

carol: quick mitigation attempt: routed a small % of traffic (5%) to fallback route model-compact in us-east-1 at 15:04Z, and bumped runtime pool-3 replicas +2 at 15:06Z. Early signs: error rate down to 3.2% in the graph.

maria: confirmed customer impact: spike affected ~25k requests/min window; roughly 5% error rate, some paying customers saw increased error rates in their dashboards. No full outage but increased latency and 5xx. We should build timeline + hypotheses in this thread.

josh: timeline so far: 15:00Z alert fires -> 15:01Z oncall acknowledged -> 15:03Z traces + kvlogs pulled -> 15:04Z fallback routed -> 15:06Z pool scaled -> 15:08Z error rate improving.

sree: hypotheses: [H1] upstream runtime hitting connection saturation (file descriptors / ephemeral ports) leading to timeouts, retries amplify load; [H2] a codepath change in runtime causing longer inference tails -> timeouts; [H3] a misconfigured network appliance in front of runtime causing transient conn drops.

ben: evidence for H1: kvlogs show increasing latency and many concurrent retries to same upstream ids up-34/up-35. Can we check per-host connection stats (netstat/ephemeral) for runtime nodes up-34/up-35?

carol: running netstat snapshot on runtime-pool-3-2 and runtime-pool-3-3:```\n# on runtime-pool-3-2
TIME_WAIT: 1200
ESTABLISHED: 420
SYN_SENT: 4
# ephemeral sockets spikes observed, file descriptors ~ 68k (limit 65536) -> approaching limit
```

olivia: that looks like fd exhaustion risk — we hit soft limits. Also see many half-open connections on the gateway side.

maria: action items: (1) SRE to confirm FD limits and raise if needed (owner: sree) (2) Product infra to audit recent runtime deploys for tail latency changes (owner: josh) (3) Keep fallback route for 30m and monitor error rate (owner: carol) (4) collect full trace bundle + kvlog tar and attach to RCA doc (owner: olivia)

sree: raising file descriptor limit on pool-3 nodes now + restarting node with rolling drain. command: `sudo sysctl -w fs.file-max=200000` and restart process via k8s rollout. Doing that in a canary -> will monitor.

josh: I'll check recent runtime images for any change to batching or concurrency flags that could increase tails. Also verify model serving config for long-lived requests.

ben: can we confirm whether any client-side spikes (large batch requests) correlate? Logs show a few large token requests but not enough to explain whole spike. Adding that as lower-priority hypothesis.

maria: keep adding notes. once stabilized we'll assemble a formal RCA doc. For now assign temporary incident channel: #incident-gw-3478901234 and set postmortem owner sree.

oncall-bot: Pager handoff: @sree is on call until 19:00Z. Please escalate to @josh if rollout changes are needed.

olivia: uploaded kvlog/trace bundle to dropbox: https://dropbox.redwood/incident-3478901234/logbundle.tar.gz — contains kvlogs, proxy logs, netstat snapshots.

carol: monitoring: error rate at 15:15Z down to 1.1%, CPU on runtime nodes stable, no further retries observed. Leaving fallback route on for 20 more mins.

maria: thanks all. Next steps: sree to update RCA doc with timeline/hypotheses/evidence and mitigation steps. I'll notify CS for customers with >1% error impact.

josh: noted. I'll run a quick audit of runtime flags and post findings to the incident doc.

sree: confirmed fd limit change applied and rolling restarts completed at 15:22Z. monitoring looks healthy. setting postmortem draft at https://docs.redwood/incidents/gw-3478901234-rca (will update with links).
